codeFindings.title: Save has no in-flight submission guard
codeFindings.detail: Each submit schedules an independent delayed callback, and the Save button is never disabled while saving. Rapid submissions can therefore trigger multiple save completions.
codeFindings.notVerifiableBecause: The callbacks overwrite the same confirmation element, so the current page exposes only one indistinguishable confirmation and performs no observable backend operation.
